beats.care: Take Metro at night, not cabs. On Panchami and Shashthi, Blue and Green Lines run 6 am to 11 pm.
beats.what: Police restrict goods vehicles for set hours on Puja days, Oct 13–19. Parking and drop-offs are banned on notified roads.
beats.why: Huge crowds move between pandals late at night. Police and Metro want crowds and roads moving.

cards.body: Metro will run Blue and Green Line trains from 1 pm to 4 am on Oct 17, 18 and 19.
cards.caption: Blue Line peak gap, Saptami–Navami

cards.body: Kalighat gets special curbs on Oct 18 and 20. Roads to Baghbazar and Nimtala ghats have no-parking rules on Oct 18. Immersion curbs run Oct 20–24.
Idol-carrying trucks can't use the AJC Bose Road flyover or Maa flyover on immersion days.

cards.q: Which Metro lines run till 4 am on Saptami to Navami?
cards.why: Only the Blue and Green Lines get night-long service; Orange is shut Oct 17–21.

cover.label: Last Metro on Saptami to Navami

hook: Pandal-hopping till dawn? *Metro runs till 4 am* this Puja

learn.t: The Orange Line will run no trains from October 17 to 21, Metro Railway says.

sources.title: Pandal hoppers rejoice! Kolkata Metro to run night-long services on peak Durga Puja days

tldr: Kolkata Police's Puja traffic curbs run Oct 13–19, and Metro's Blue and Green Lines go till 4 am on Saptami to Navami.
watch: Night-long Metro on Blue and Green Lines runs Oct 17–19, 1 pm to 4 am; immersion curbs start Oct 20.
